title: A Study to Determine the Safety and Effectiveness of RAD001 (Everolimus) in Patients With Lymphangioleiomyomatosis

sections.abstract:
This was an exploratory study to determine whether escalating doses of RAD001 (everolimus) were safe and effective in patients with Lymphangioleiomyomatosis

Posted outcomes: Change From Baseline in Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor-D (VEGF-D) Concentrations. timeframe=Baseline, 26 weeks. Everolimus 2.5 mg/Day=-464.3 (±745.23); Everolimus 5 mg/Day=-1113.2 (±1468.9); Everolimus 10 mg/Day=-1771.7 (±2091.6)
